inputs.text: Yet another overreach from the New York politicians in their 2026 State of the State agenda. They're proposing rules that would force guns sold in the state to be built so they can't be easily modified into illegal machine guns, along with criminal penalties for violations. This is being dressed up as some effort against structural inequalities and corporate power, but it's really just another progressive attack on our constitutional traditions of self-reliance and the right to defend our families. Instead of promoting personal responsibility, strong law enforcement, and cultural order, these reforms put more restrictions on law-abiding citizens while ignoring the real drivers of disorder like family breakdown and failed urban policies. We need to reject this kind of government meddling that weakens national strength in the name of protecting the vulnerable.
